name: Exterior Soffit RP Surface Preparation
intent: RP prep — wash, mildew biocide, scrape/feather (condition-driven), degloss/scuff, caulk repair, vent cleaning, substrate-specific spot scuff, dust cleanup.
doctrine: RP prep. Condition modifier (GOOD:1.0, FAIR:1.5, POOR:2.0) on scrape/feather. RRP modifier (2.0x) stacks on scrape/feather. Mildew biocide conditional on presence — soffit is #1 exterior surface for mildew. No chalk remediation (chalk washed off during low-pressure wash). No alkali scuff (masonry feature). Vinyl scuff for exposed areas only. Vent cleaning for paint-clogged vents. All overhead rates baked in. Open-face modifier (2.0x) applies.
